title: White Paper - Part 3 of 4 - Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 3: Data, Validation Ledger, and Falsification Protocol
abstract: Presents a structured validation ledger for Energy-Flow Cosmology (102 registered tests), two sealed blind predictions with cryptographic provenance, and a pre-registered falsification protocol for Stage-IV surveys. Reports a persistent but non-detection growth-sector signal (αL2 = −1.00 ± 0.46, ΔAIC = −2.91) and defines sharp kill criteria that would compel abandoning EFC.
